body.name: Two-horizon staggered-adoption strict-gap instance
body.construction: Let \(N=4\), \(T=3\), \(K=1\), \(p=1\), \(T_1=2\), \(T_2=3\), and \(T_3=T_4=\infty\). Take \(\mathcal J=\{1\}\), \(x_i=0\) for all units, \(L=\delta=0\), \(\alpha=1/20\), and \(z_B=9/4\) with a certified Gaussian-tail enclosure. Let \(R_Q\) be diagonal, with diagonal entry \(1\) for every cell at time \(2\) and \(1/10\) for every cell at time \(3\). Then \(D_{1,0}=\{2,3,4\}\) and \(D_{1,1}=\{3,4\}\); the deep rule uses \(\{3,4\}\) at both horizons.
